name: Country Syllabub
description: Historical recipe from Miss Leslie's Complete Cookery (1851). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: white sugar
ingredients.originalText: half a pound of white sugar

ingredients.name: one pint of fine sweet cider or of white wine
ingredients.originalText: one pint of fine sweet cider or of white wine
ingredients.quantityText: one pint of fine sweet cider or of white wine

instructions.text: Mix half a pound of white sugar with a pint of fine sweet cider or of white wine and grate in a nutmeg
Prepare them in a large bowl just before milking time
Have about three pints milked into it, stirring it occasionally with a spoon
Let it be eaten before the froth subsides
If you use cider, a little brandy will improve it

source.author: Eliza Leslie
source.originalInstructions:
1. Mix half a pound of white sugar with a pint of fine sweet cider or of white wine and grate in a nutmeg
2. Prepare them in a large bowl just before milking time
3. Have about three pints milked into it, stirring it occasionally with a spoon
4. Let it be eaten before the froth subsides
5. If you use cider, a little brandy will improve it
